subject: english
stem: The school office has sent the following message. Which detail is stated in the message?
options: photos are not allowed in the Bike Safety Fair model room
photos are not allowed in the Bike Safety Fair photo hall
photos are not allowed anywhere during Bike Safety Fair
photos are not allowed in the Bike Safety Fair workshop

optionRationales.reason: photos are not allowed in the Bike Safety Fair model room：此項把「workshop」改成「model room」。音稿明確陳述「photos are not allowed in the Bike Safety Fair workshop」。因此，鎖定證據支持「photos are not allowed in the Bike Safety Fair workshop」。

photos are not allowed in the Bike Safety Fair photo hall：此項把「workshop」改成「photo hall」。音稿明確陳述「photos are not allowed in the Bike Safety Fair workshop」。因此，鎖定證據支持「photos are not allowed in the Bike Safety Fair workshop」。

photos are not allowed anywhere during Bike Safety Fair：此項把「in the Bike Safety Fair workshop」改成「anywhere during Bike Safety Fair」。音稿明確陳述「photos are not allowed in the Bike Safety Fair workshop」。因此，鎖定證據支持「photos are not allowed in the Bike Safety Fair workshop」。
photos are not allowed in the Bike Safety Fair workshop：完整逐字稿明確支持此項。音稿明確陳述「photos are not allowed in the Bike Safety Fair workshop」。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：逐句比對鎖定逐字稿，答案為「photos are not allowed in the Bike Safety Fair workshop」。
獨立覆核 B：重新依時間順序核對說話者、細節與行動，只有「photos are not allowed in the Bike Safety Fair workshop」成立。
